title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A wrapped class header no longer hides its constructor properties
summary: When ktlint wraps a long class header the primary constructor lands on the line below, and the parser did not read it. 37 properties were invisible on a project of 5088 files.

highlights.title: Constructor properties under a wrapped header
highlights.description: A bare constructor on its own line, one carrying modifiers, or the Dagger shape with the annotation on a line of its own: the properties are indexed again, so the Outline, Go to Definition and Find Usages reach them.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: 42 sites on a real project, 37 properties recovered, no symbol lost and none added anywhere else.
Both stored indexes are rebuilt, so the properties appear on upgrade rather than when each affected file happens to be edited.
